text: Take the next right. Are you sure? This is a runway. We must have missed the turn. Tell Grime holding for instructions. Air China 001 just about to call you. You missed Tango. You may proceed down 5 left. It's not active. Turn left on Echo. Turn right on Sierra to the runway. Try not to miss Sierra or you'll be on the active runway. What did the crew do wrong?
